facts.statement: The week's Community event was a Ghostly Pet Party hidden deep in the Blackspore swamp; players were asked to bring a ghost pet and wear a costume.
facts.quote: This week's event is a Ghostly Pet Party hidden deep in the Blackspore swamp.

facts.statement: The Ghostly Pet Party ran on Thursday October 7, 2010 at 3pm Pacific Time (U.S. and Latin America) on Server 1.
facts.quote: Thursday October 7th, 2010 3pm Pacific Time (U.S. and Latin America) Server 1

facts.statement: A second Ghostly Pet Party ran on Friday October 8, 2010 at 9:00am Pacific Time (4:00pm GMT) for UK and Europe on Server 1.
facts.quote: Friday October 8th, 2010 9:00am Pacific Time / 4:00pm GMT (UK and Europe) Server 1

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A Free Realms community-event news post for October 2010's Super Spooktacular month. It announces a Ghostly Pet Party in the Blackspore swamp on two server-1 time slots (Thursday October 7 and Friday October 8, 2010), and explains how to find community events through the Game Guide calendar. The post date is not shown; the page says it was posted 4 days, 9 hours before capture.
